a45ae4d4c0.q: How did Boardroom Salon for Men increase member tip income after implementing a subscription membership model?
a45ae4d4c0.a: Tips actually increased after implementing the membership model because payment pain is felt at two separate times. When members are billed at the beginning of the month and then receive service later, they feel more generous and tip higher compared to paying $80 upfront and immediately considering the tip amount. This behavior validates the hypothesis that splitting payment reduces the psychological pain of the total transaction.

c95b9ee87e.q: Why did Jeff Healthcutt pivot Boardroom Salon for Men back to franchising after initially planning corporate store expansion?
c95b9ee87e.a: Healthcutt discovered that franchising is superior because franchisees living in the market every day wear the brand's logo in their community—at their vehicle, country clubs, golf clubs, and church—actively extending Boardroom in every conversation. Franchisees have stronger personal accountability and community integration than employees, and finding employees with that passion level is much harder to replicate.

c546acc2f6.q: What was Boardroom Salon for Men's customer haircut frequency gap that drove the membership program?
c546acc2f6.a: Research showed that on average men get 12 haircuts per year, generally once monthly, but Boardroom's long-term clients who had been with the brand for four, five, or six years were only visiting four times per year. This data unlocked the insight that membership could address the gap between potential addressable market and actual visits by creating a routine at an attractive price point.

f40854aa55.q: When was Boardroom Salon for Men founded and by whom?
f40854aa55.a: Boardroom Salon for Men was founded in 2004 by Bruce and his wife Heather. Bruce came up with the concept after reading an article on a flight about luxury experiences that were predominantly centered around women, prompting him to create a luxury grooming salon designed specifically for men. The brand has since weathered multiple recessions and COVID-19 while maintaining exceptional employee loyalty.
